title: Before the First Point
style: big band jazz, female lead vocal, walking bass, brass groove, calm focus energy, motivational spoken word, building anthem, choir finale, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[Intro]

(spoken, calm)

Before you walk on that court,

there's work to do.

Not with the paddle.

With the mind.

[Verse 1]

Pull up to the courts, take a breath in slow

Don't rush the warm up, let the body know

Shake out the shoulders, roll out the neck

You're not here to worry, you're here to connect

Leave the morning at the gate right there

Whatever happened, it doesn't live here

This rectangle of court is yours right now

Step in with intention, this is how

[Pre-Chorus]

You can't control the wind or their shot

You can only control what you've got

The breath, the focus, the decision made

That is the game before the game is played

[Chorus]

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

SET THE MIND BEFORE THE PADDLE

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

WHAT YOU THINK IS WHAT YOU PLAY

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

BREATHE IN SLOW AND SEE IT CLEARLY

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

YOU ARE READY FOR TODAY

[Verse 2]

Nerves are not the enemy, they mean you care

Channel them forward, use them, they're fuel not fear

Heart rate rising, that's your body saying go

Breathe out slow and let the tension go

Focus on the ball, not the scoreboard there

Not the opponents watching, not who's in the chair

One point at a time, that's the only math

Stay in your lane and stay on your path

[Pre-Chorus]

Between each point, reset and release

Three deep breaths, return to peace

Shake it off, the last one's gone

Pick up your paddle and carry on

[Chorus]

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

SET THE MIND BEFORE THE PADDLE

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

WHAT YOU THINK IS WHAT YOU PLAY

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

BREATHE IN SLOW AND SEE IT CLEARLY

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

YOU ARE READY FOR TODAY

[Bridge]

(spoken, deliberate)

Here's what the best players know.

The score is just information.

A missed shot is just feedback.

The opponent across the net is not the obstacle.

Your own head is the obstacle.

So you train the head first.

Before every point, one breath.

After every error, let it go.

After every winner, let it go.

Stay level. Stay present.

The court is three metres wide on your side.

That's your world right now.

[Verse 3]

After the point, paddle down, walk slow

Don't carry the last one into the next, let go

Spin the paddle, bounce it on the ground

Find your breath, find your feet, find your sound

Visualise the next shot before you serve

See it land soft, see the line, see the curve

Then step up ready, committed and clear

The mental game starts right here

[Final Chorus]

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

SET THE MIND BEFORE THE PADDLE

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

WHAT YOU THINK IS WHAT YOU PLAY

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

BREATHE IN SLOW AND SEE IT CLEARLY

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

YOU ARE READY FOR TODAY

ONE BREATH IN, LET THE NOISE GO

ONE STEP FORWARD, OWN THE SPACE

BEFORE THE FIRST POINT

YOU WERE BORN READY FOR THIS PLACE

[Outro]

(spoken)

One breath.

One point.

One court.

Your mind first.

Always.

Before the first point.
